hero.heading: 3DNAtor MAX
hero.text: Create unique products using advanced 3D printing technologies. Innovate your business!

1.title: Individual Approach to Each Customer
1.text: We offer our customers an individual approach to every project. Our team of professional designers and engineers works on each order to create a product that precisely meets the needs and desires of our clients

2.title: Quality and Prompt Order Fulfillment
2.text: We guarantee high-quality products and swift order processing. Our products undergo rigorous quality control to ensure compliance with industry standards. We also process orders quickly to ensure our clients receive their products in the shortest possible time

3.title: Flexible Collaboration Terms
3.text: We provide flexible collaboration terms, allowing our clients to obtain high-quality products at optimal prices. We are also ready to discuss various payment and delivery options to make our cooperation as convenient as possible for our clients

fdm_printing.heading: FDM-3D printing
fdm_printing.text: Fused Deposition Modeling (FDM) 3D printing is one of the most common and accessible 3D printing technologies. It is based on the method of extruding plastic material through a nozzle, layer by layer, until the desired shape is created. Our 3D printers offer high precision and detail, allowing the production of objects of varying complexity, including prototypes, spare parts, unique designer items, and much more. FDM-3D printing is also known for its speed and reliability, making it ideal for small and medium production runs. Our team of professionals is ready to assist you in realizing projects of any complexity using FDM-3D printing technology.

faq.heading: FAQ
faq.subheading: You can always ask your questions in our

questions.1: What are the advantages of 3D printing for industrial enterprises?
questions.2: Which type of 3D printing is best suited for my project?
questions.3: What materials can be used in 3D printing?
questions.4: How long does it take to 3D print one object?
questions.5: What are the cost and process of ordering 3D printing?

answers.1: 3D printing in the industry enables rapid prototyping, reduces the time from idea to production, and minimizes material waste.
answers.2: The choice depends on the requirements: FDM for prototypes, SLA for highly detailed parts, SLS for functional components.
answers.3: We use ABS, PLA, HIPS, PA-6, Pa-1, POM, PPS, PPS-CF, PPS-GF, TPU-GF, TPU-CF, ABS-AR, basf metalfuse and composite materials based on them.
answers.4: The time varies based on size, complexity, and method, ranging from a few hours to several days.
answers.5: Costs depend on the object and method. The order begins with providing a 3D model and project assessment.
